receipt.title: The receipt behind this number
receipt.triggerLabelTemplate: See how the {ccy} number was made
receipt.evidenceSentenceTemplate: {words} put the median price to buy a dollar at {price} {ccy}.
receipt.evidenceOffersNote: Every offer collected that hour is listed below.
receipt.evidenceAggregateNote: Only the median was stored for this hour — the individual offers were not kept.
receipt.rateSentenceTemplate: The official rate captured in the same pass: {value} {ccy} to the dollar, from {source}.
receipt.rateManaged: A rate the government sets and defends.
receipt.ratePegged: A rate this currency is pegged to.
receipt.rateUnmaintained: A rate that has stopped being updated — this compares against an average of what banks quote instead.
receipt.rateStalenessNote: This value is refreshed every hour but the underlying source itself only changes about once a day, so it can be up to 24 hours behind the market.
receipt.verdictPublished: Published — the evidence rule was met.
receipt.verdictNoteOrderBook: The minimum-offer rule applies to peer-to-peer sources only. This price comes from an order book or a broker quote instead, evidenced by how many exchanges quoted it.
receipt.verdictNoteAggregate: A single aggregated price from an independent source, not a two-sided listing board — there is no offer count to test.
receipt.loadErrorTemplate: The receipt at {file} could not be read.

receiptCorridor.title: The receipt behind this cost
receiptCorridor.evidenceBuySentenceTemplate: Buying the stablecoin on {venue}: the best price on offer was {topPrice} {ccy}, the average price actually paid was {avgPrice} {ccy}.
receiptCorridor.evidenceSellSentenceTemplate: Selling the stablecoin on {venue}: the best price on offer was {topPrice} {ccy}, the average price actually received was {avgPrice} {ccy}.
receiptCorridor.evidenceBookNote: The individual order book levels used for this are not saved — only the prices and amount filled that they produced.
receiptCorridor.feeNotPricedTemplate: {label}: not priced yet — no published free method was found.
receiptCorridor.feeNotModeledTemplate: {label}: not priced for this corridor yet.
receiptCorridor.feeNotAvailableTemplate: {label}: not available for this sample yet.
receiptCorridor.withdrawalLabel: Getting it into a bank account
receiptCorridor.networkFeeAmountTemplate: The fee to move the stablecoin itself: {amount} in stablecoin.
receiptCorridor.mathSentence: Every fee above, added together, as a share of the amount sent.
receiptCorridor.regimeMarket: This is the market order price — paying whatever is on offer right now.
receiptCorridor.regimeLimit: This is the limit order price — setting your own price and waiting for it to fill.
receiptCorridor.noLegsNote: This site only breaks the market-order cost into step-by-step fees. The limit-order total is real but shown as one number, not a breakdown.
receiptCorridor.loadErrorTemplate: The receipt at {file} could not be read.

receiptPriceChange.title: The receipt behind this price change
receiptPriceChange.step2Label: The check against every other company
receiptPriceChange.checkSentenceTemplate: Checked against every other company quoting the same amount on this route: {nAgree} of {nOther} others moved the same way, by at least {thresholdPts} percentage points, over the same two days.
receiptPriceChange.checkNote: A company only counts as having changed its price when every other company measured against it agrees on the direction -- that is what tells a real repricing apart from the day's exchange rate moving everyone at once.
receiptPriceChange.mathSentenceTemplate: {provider}'s own price on {newDay} was {newCostPct}%. The confirmed move was {movePct} percentage points, so {oldDay} is treated as {oldCostPct}%.
receiptPriceChange.mathPrevNoteTemplate: The price actually measured on {oldDay} was {prevCostPct}% -- it differs from the {oldCostPct}% above only because the exchange rate itself drifted that day, which this check is built to ignore.
receiptPriceChange.verdictChangeTemplate: Recorded as a price change: {provider} moved and every other company in the comparison did not.
receiptPriceChange.verdictWeekendUpTemplate: Recorded as a weekend rise: the price went up on a Saturday and came back down within the next two days.
receiptPriceChange.verdictWeekendBackTemplate: The Saturday rise above, reversing back down.
receiptPriceChange.loadErrorTemplate: The receipt at {file} could not be read.

receiptMeter.title: Where this count comes from
receiptMeter.commitsEvidenceTemplate: {total} changes landed in the site's code today ({day}); {excluded} of those were merged pull requests, not a fresh price check.
receiptMeter.hoursEvidenceTemplate: Every hour from {start} to {end} UTC has at least one price landing in both of the files the site checks for delivery.

receiptProvider.title: The receipt behind this cost
receiptProvider.evidenceComparisonSentenceTemplate: A public price comparison service quotes {provider}: sending this amount lands {landed} after every fee.
receiptProvider.evidenceOwnSentenceTemplate: {provider}'s own published quote: at a rate of {rate}, with a stated fee of {fee}, sending this amount lands {received}.
receiptProvider.evidenceOwnNoteTemplate: {provider} also publishes its own quote directly, at a rate of {rate} and a fee of {fee}. This page shows the public comparison figure here instead, so every provider is checked the same independent way.
receiptProvider.evidenceMissingTemplate: {provider} has not quoted this corridor and size this particular hour.
receiptProvider.evidenceUnavailableTemplate: The receipt behind this figure could not be found.
receiptProvider.mathSentence: The share of the amount sent this costs, measured against the mid-market exchange rate at the time.

receiptCrossover.title: The receipt behind this number
receiptCrossover.evidenceSentenceTemplate: {n} real samples at this size, collected between {first} and {last}. The best other app's typical cost across those same hours was {baseline}.
receiptCrossover.feeSentenceTemplate: At {volume} a month, Independent Reserve's own published tier table drops its fee to {feeIr}, and Coins.ph's drops to about {feeCoins} — it varies slightly sample to sample, since it's based on each sample's own real prices.
receiptCrossover.reconstructionNote: This number was never watched happening — it is rebuilt from every real sample's own real prices, swapping in only the fee this volume would unlock.
receiptCrossover.reconstructionSentenceTemplate: The typical rebuilt cost at this volume: {result}.
receiptCrossover.searchSentenceTemplate: We tested monthly amounts from {lo} to {hi} and narrowed in on the exact point where that rebuilt cost first drops below the best other app's typical cost: {volume} a month.
receiptCrossover.regimeMarket: This is the market order version — paying whatever price is on offer right now.
receiptCrossover.regimeLimit: This is the limit order version — setting your own price and waiting for it to fill.

receiptBasis.title: Where this price comes from
receiptBasis.evidenceSentenceTemplate: {n} people were buying and selling US dollar stablecoins for {ccy} when this was checked: a median buy price of {buy} and a median sell price of {sell}.
receiptBasis.rateSentenceTemplate: The bank rate for {ccy} at the same moment: {rate} {ccy} per dollar.
receiptBasis.rateUnavailable: No bank rate was available for {ccy} at this check.
receiptBasis.mathSentenceTemplate: Street price = the midpoint of the buy and sell medians = ({buy} + {sell}) / 2 = {mid} {ccy}.
